description: Shows how the connected account's AI receptionist is set up right now, as callers hear it: business name, about text and address, the How to Handle Calls handbook, the receptionist's name and greetings, what it does after hours, whether confirmation emails go out, and the business hours (read-only). Also lists the last few published versions, for restore_ai_setup_version. Call this before update_ai_setup so a change is based on the current wording.
name: get_ai_setup

_environment.description: The Nexwin country and environment that supplied the result
